'''Brody Johnson''', who went by the name '''Johnson Smith''' after he went into hiding, was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] alive during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Brody Johnson appeared as a non-player character in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
